transcript.text: I need to flag a compliance issue before we proceed. I received a compliance memo this morning confirming that guarantees for the company's government-related beneficiaries are subject to a $6,000,000 aggregate exposure cap and require sanctions screening before each issuance. This memo has not yet been entered in the facility file, so it wouldn't have been visible in the preliminary terms review. Given that the preliminary terms contain no beneficiary cap and no issuance-level monitoring controls, we need to address this before a decision is recorded.

transcript.text: I also need to flag findings from my review of the supplier contracts this week. The beneficiaries require exactly a 10% cash margin on each guarantee, and each guarantee must have an exactly 180-day term. I have not yet circulated the contract schedule to the committee, so this wouldn't have been reflected in the preliminary terms review either.
